method: Every finding below was read directly from the checked-out repository or the GitHub API on 2026-11-27; each row gives the file, the line or command, and what it shows. No finding is inferred.
headline: The repository is not broken — all 5 published session sites and the two root builds resolve their internal links (0 broken local refs across docs/**/*.html and 7 root pages). The problems are duplication, drift between published pages, and a deploy configuration that serves unchecked files.

findings.title: Published pages contradict each other on hotel pricing
findings.evidence: The Pages root page index.html line 58 states 'Caesars Palace $226/nt + tax ($1,582/7nts before tax) • The Venetian $6,170.43 all-in for 7 nts'. Today's live check of the same official engines for the same dates returns Caesars run-of-house at $209/night (→ $1,463) and The Venetian returning no price at all. Two different figures for the same hotel and week are live at once, and the Venetian figure cannot be reproduced today.
findings.impact: Two different all-in numbers for the same hotel and week are live at once; the Venetian figure cannot be reproduced today.
findings.how_to_fix: Re-price both hotels and publish one dated snapshot; state the capture date next to every price.

findings.title: An unverified travel time is presented as fact
findings.evidence: index.html line 63: 'reachable in ~15–20 minutes by car, rideshare, RTC Deuce bus, or the Las Vegas Monorail'. No official page publishes that figure. The same page's own footnote says travel times are unverified.
findings.impact: A reader could plan around 15–20 minutes. The honest position is 'no published travel-time data'.
findings.how_to_fix: Replace with the documented frequencies (Deuce ~every 15 min; Monorail every 4–8 min) and a link to the RTC trip planner.

findings.title: Wrong lead time quoted for the MICHELIN Guide date
findings.evidence: index.html line 48 says the guide was 'awarded Aug 26, 2026'. The MICHELIN press release is dated 31 Aug 2026 ('31 Aug 2026').
findings.impact: Minor factual error on the landing page of the site the owner sees.

findings.title: Trip length is stated three different ways
findings.evidence: index.html line 43 says 'Preferred: Feb 15 – 18, 2027 (3–4 nights)'. Feb 15→18 is 3 nights, not 3–4. The brief also asks for 1–2 weeks and for 7-night prices.
findings.impact: The single most important input to every price calculation is ambiguous.
findings.how_to_fix: State '3 nights (Feb 15–18)' and keep 7-night and 14-night as explicitly separate scenarios.

findings.title: Two build systems publish to the same Pages URL with different configurations
findings.evidence: The GitHub Pages API reports build_type 'legacy', source branch 'main', path '/'. The workflow .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads the 'docs' directory (line 27). Under legacy root hosting the live root is the repository root (index.html + assets/), while the workflow deploys docs/.
findings.impact: Careful readers can see different content at / and in the Actions artifact. Five separate session sites (059c3126, 2e5e3452, 36cc5108, b29fc34e, d33551df) also coexist with overlapping subject matter.
findings.how_to_fix: Pick one source (docs/ recommended) in Settings → Pages, and add a root redirect to it.

findings.title: CI never checks the pages actually served at the root
findings.evidence: Every workflow gates only generated session folders (pages-check.yml → docs/session-059c3126; validate.yml → docs/session-b29fc34e; validate-field-notes.yml → docs/session-2e5e3452). No workflow validates the seven root HTML pages that legacy hosting serves.
findings.impact: Errors R-01 to R-04 could not have been caught by CI, and can repeat any time the root pages are hand-edited.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a check that parses each root page, requires a <a href> source on every table row, and fails on placeholder text.

findings.title: A published session page still carries a superseded star count
findings.evidence: docs/session-36cc5108/flagged.html contains the phrase 'three starred' inside flag F29, describing an older dashboard. The live total is four.
findings.impact: Low, because the same text is explaining that the old figure was wrong, but a keyword search for 'three starred' surfaces it as if current.
findings.how_to_fix: Quote the old figure in quotation marks and add 'superseded' beside it.

findings.title: The primary price comparison uses a room type the brief may not accept
findings.evidence: For Caesars Palace on Feb 15–22, 2027 the engine offered 'Room Type Assigned on Arrival' ($209/night) and 'Julius Deluxe 1 King' ($214/night). No two-queen room appeared. 'Assigned on arrival' does not guarantee a queen-or-larger bed, which the brief requires.
findings.impact: A savings figure may rest on a room that cannot be shown to meet the bed requirement.
findings.how_to_fix: Only compare named 2-queen rooms; treat run-of-house rates as ineligible for this trip.

findings.title: No LICENSE file in the repository
findings.evidence: ls LICENSE* → 'No such file or directory'. There is a .gitignore (4 rules) and a README that begins with the planner description.
findings.impact: Anyone reusing the repository has no stated licence terms. Not a site defect.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a LICENSE (the owner's choice of terms).

findings.title: Root pages carry raw HTML entity/emoji markup
findings.evidence: index.html contains 3 occurrences of raw '&#x' entity sequences including an inline SVG favicon built from escaped markup in the href attribute.
findings.impact: Cosmetic and fragile: some browsers and validators reject a data-URI SVG written that way.
findings.how_to_fix: Move the favicon to a real .svg file.

findings.title: README points at a live site whose root is not the documented site
findings.evidence: README says the session planner is published at '/session-059c3126/' and the landing page is 'the verified landing page'; index.html has 0 links to docs/ and docs/index.html has 0 links back to the root, so the two halves of the published site are not navigable from one another.
findings.impact: A visitor landing at / cannot reach the detailed verified pages; a visitor in docs/ cannot get back.
findings.how_to_fix: Add one link each way, or serve a single site.

clean_checks: 0 broken local references across every HTML file in docs/** (checked 40 pages).
0 broken local references across the 7 root HTML pages.
No loopback-host strings, placeholder lorem text, or developer code markers in any published HTML, JS or CSS under docs/, site/, assets/ or field-notes/.
All five session sites build reproducibly under their own check scripts; python3 scripts/check_site.py, validate_field_notes.py and check_session_b29fc34e.py all exit 0.
Pages is enabled, public, HTTPS-enforced, and the latest build status is 'built'.
